data.name: Raonar
data.gender_notes: Raonar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raonar is derived from the Arabic language and is a combination of the words 'Ra' (Sun) and 'Onar' (Moon). This name signifies the beautiful union and balance between the Sun and the Moon, representing the duality of nature and the harmony in the universe. The name Raonar carries the meaning “Sun and Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raonar usually hope their child will grow to embody sun and moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Raonar is believed to have spiritual significance in Islam, as it represents the sun and moon, which are often seen as symbols of Allah's power and divine guidance. It is said that those named Raonar are blessed with a deep connection to nature and a strong sense of spirituality.
data.etymology: Raonar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun and Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raonar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
